svg.title: THE ZONE BACK - the introduction, where the game starts (A4 landscape)
svg.desc: Glues to the reverse of the-zone-FRONT, same size, same orientation: flip about the long edge. Every board starts the game showing its back, and this is the one the table reads first: what the game is, how it ends, and the five steps of set-up. When set-up is done, THE ZONE and THE PROJECT turn over and week 1 begins; THE TEAM and SHIT HAPPENS turn over in week 2. Character parts are named by what they are (upbringing, instinct, values, education, skill), never by body part.
svg.text: HIGH-PERFORMANCE TEAM
THE ZONE · START HERE
THE ONE IDEA
A week is five days,
and you choose them.
THE GAME
Seven weeks. Six features, A to F, to deliver
before week 7 closes. You lay the team's five
days before you know what is coming, then the
Events land on the plan you already made.
Everyone plays together. Nobody plays alone.
HOW IT ENDS
Deliver everything, then add up the Team Score.
It is printed on the back of THE PROJECT, with
the four results. It says whether you finished,
and whether you built a team that could do it
again.
SET UP, IN FIVE STEPS
Deal and build. Each of you is dealt five parts
at random: upbringing, instinct, values,
education and a skill. Nobody chooses.
Take your tiles. Your NEED and your HERO.
On your SKILLS grid, mark the square where your
education meets your skill. That is where you start.
Pick a Project card. It names the six features.
Motivation 5, Capital 0, week marker on 1.
Shuffle the Events. Do not draw yet.

text.tspan: Turn THE ZONE and THE PROJECT over.

svg.text: Put a tile on your start square of THE ZONE.
Play week 1. Lay five cards from Work,
Engagement, Celebrate, Workshop and Plan, resolve
them, bank what is finished, check your NEED,
and take the grind.
EVERY BOARD STARTS ON ITS BACK
Each back says when to turn it over. THE ZONE and THE PROJECT turn over now, at the start of week 1.
THE TEAM and SHIT HAPPENS turn over in week 2, THE DEVELOPMENT in week 3.
